definitions.explanation: The feeling of sadness or displeasure caused by unfulfilled hopes or expectations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧{失望|しつぼう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was disappointed when I failed the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{失望|しつぼう}⟦させられた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was disappointed by his attitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦だけに→だけに：noentry⟧、{失望|しつぼう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}えずに→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{黙|だま}って→黙る：02287_damaru⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れた→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧。
examples.english: Because my expectations were high, my disappointment was equally great. Unable to say anything, I quietly left the place.

notes:
{失望|しつぼう} expresses disappointment or loss of hope, typically when expectations are not met.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {失望|しつぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be disappointed)
- {失望|しつぼう}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ (to disappoint someone)
- {失望|しつぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel disappointment)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{失望|しつぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be disappointed in/by ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {失望|しつぼう}: disappointment (formal, stronger emotion)
- ⟦がっかり→がっかり：00054_gakkari⟧: disappointment (casual, everyday expression)
- ⟦{落胆|らくたん}→落胆：04860_rakutan⟧: discouragement, dejection (written/formal)

REGISTER: Somewhat formal. In casual conversation, ⟦がっかり→がっかり：00054_gakkari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is more common.
